verdict.rationale: Steel documents computer-use integrations for OpenAI, Claude and Gemini that run vision-based agent loops on a Steel browser session. Its browser tools also expose screenshot capture, so screenshot-driven operation is a documented path alongside DOM/CDP control. The vision loop itself comes from the model provider rather than a native Steel action mode, and the evidence consists of brief one-line descriptions. missing for 10: explicit evidence of switching modes within one session, documentation of handling canvas or non-DOM UIs, coordinate-level action details, independent hands-on corroboration
